description: Source code for a module implementing virtual host mapping using a backend DBI interface in the lighttpd web server. Contains functions for database connection management, query execution, and plugin initialization.

classes.name: vhostdb_config
classes.description: Holds database connection and query configuration for virtual host lookups.

classes.name: plugin_data
classes.description: Main plugin data structure including defaults and configuration.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_dbi_error_callback
methods.description: Handles database connection errors and retries connection.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_dbconf_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with database configuration.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_dbconf_setup
methods.description: Sets up database connection based on configuration options.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_patch_config
methods.description: Applies plugin configuration patches to request context.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_dbi_query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query to retrieve the document root for a virtual host.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_merge_config
methods.description: Merges plugin configuration into current config.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_dbi_plugin_init
methods.description: Registers the plugin with the server.
